_why: A document that indexes its own directory is opting into completeness: if it omits a file, the reader has no way to know the list is short, because a short index and a complete one look identical. Coverage is declared here rather than detected, because detection mis-classifies -- traceability-index.md has an index heading and indexes decisions, not the files beside it, and pointing a directory check at it reports defects that are not there. Local link resolution runs over every other document. A governed projection whose relative links resolve only after materialization into its consumer tree is exempt only at an exact content digest; changing any byte invalidates the exemption. That list is empty now and stays empty until something needs it: the three projections that held digests were carrying links into another checkout, and those are code spans since the document-routing gate started running, so the exemption shielded nothing. An exemption nobody spends stops describing a constraint and becomes a permanent hole.
